slides.title: Drone strike reportedly hits a school in Amhara
slides.body: Sana Elementary School, Dera district, Oct. 20

slides.title: children reported killed, 20+ injured
slides.body: Addis Standard reported; other accounts give 7 to 10 dead. Not independently verified.

slides.title: A teacher's account
slides.body: A teacher told Addis Standard that 150+ students were in the morning shift and no armed people were nearby.

slides.title: Disputed, no official response
slides.body: Pro-government accounts claimed Fano fighters were targeted. The military has not commented.

slides.title: Protect schools. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica · Oct 22, 2026
